subject.title: Slack: Include file attachment metadata in inbound message delivery to agents

question: What shared inbound attachment metadata shape should agents receive for Slack, Discord, Telegram, and future channel plugins?
rationale: The remaining work changes the channel-to-agent context contract and privacy boundary; a Slack-only field would likely become a competing source of truth.

options.title: Design Shared Metadata
options.body: Add a cross-channel attachment metadata field with stable names and privacy rules, then implement Slack as the first mapper.

options.title: Use Slack Stopgap
options.body: Expose only Slack file metadata now, accepting a later migration if other channels need the same facts.

options.title: Keep Current Placeholders
options.body: Treat fileId placeholders plus download-file guidance as the supported workflow and close the metadata request after maintainer confirmation.

recommendation.title: Design Shared Metadata
recommendation.body: Add a cross-channel attachment metadata field with stable names and privacy rules, then implement Slack as the first mapper.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest current-history signal on the Slack media and shared inbound media contract surfaces and were also pulled into the issue discussion.
